VBO:0200585.summary: Attentive, lively and closely attached to its people, the German Spitz has a long tradition as a watchful companion around homes and farms. Willingness to learn is shared across a family ranging from the larger Wolfspitz and Giant to Medium, Miniature and Toy sizes. The familiar medium dogs once kept watch for artisans, farmers and wagoners.
VBO:0200585.shortDescription: Attentive and lively, German Spitz dogs share a watchful companion tradition across a wide family of sizes.
